activity_statements.statement: originates residential mortgages digitally through Rocket Mortgage, having originated over $1.8 trillion in home loans as the nation's leading retail mortgage lender
has completed over 1 million e-closings, processing mortgage transactions entirely digitally without physical document signing
operates a Detroit-based technology platform enabling fast digital mortgage approvals and streamlined loan processing
provides personal loans and real estate agent services through its ecosystem of cross-selling businesses
achieves a 97% client retention rate through digital customer experience and brand loyalty in the mortgage category

name_reality_gap: The 'Financial Services & Insurance' index label implies a traditional financial firm; Rocket Companies is a fintech built on proprietary technology — it was one of the first companies to fully digitize the mortgage closing process and operates more like a software company that makes its money from mortgage origination than a traditional bank or lender.
